title: cairn install puts repo-root bin on the Windows user PATH
intention: On Windows, `cairn install` makes sure <repo>/bin is on the persisted user Path, without duplicating it or disturbing existing entries, so `cairn` resolves in any new PowerShell with no hand step.
why: Measured 2026-11-15 on akienlivingroom: `cairn superclaude` in PowerShell gave "The term 'cairn' is not recognized"; the User Path held only WindowsApps and ~/.local/bin. Outline 5.4.3.7 makes repo-root bin/ "the one thing on PATH", but nothing on Windows puts it there: the installer setx's CAIRN_HOME_HOST (installer.py ask_cairn_home) and never touches Path. bin/proofs/test_cairn_resolves_from_powershell.py checks only PATHEXT resolution inside bin/, so it is green on a box where cairn cannot be found. CC added it by hand ([Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable, not setx, which truncates at 1024). Fields drafted by akienlivingroom_cc_0, 2026-11-17.
traces_to: Outline 5.4.3.7 (repo-root bin is the one thing on PATH); Law 4 (a rule that matters is enforced by physics).
how: A new ensure_bin_on_path(*, dry_run, repo=None, env_reader=None, env_writer=None) beside ensure_journal_merge_driver in installer.py, called from install() and listed in the dry run. It reads HKCU\Environment Path with winreg, compares case-insensitively after os.path.normcase and stripping the trailing separator, and if bin is absent writes existing.rstrip(';') + ';' + bin as REG_EXPAND_SZ, then broadcasts WM_SETTINGCHANGE 'Environment' with SendMessageTimeoutW. Never setx. Off Windows it returns not_applicable. The proof injects the reader and writer, so the real registry is never touched.

clauses.claim: with HKCU Path lacking bin, install() leaves bin on the Path exactly once
every existing Path entry stays byte-identical and in the same order
a dry run writes nothing and reports the step
off Windows the step is not_applicable and writes nothing

decisions.text: D1: ensure_bin_on_path beside ensure_journal_merge_driver, called from install() and listed in the dry run; winreg read, normcase compare, REG_EXPAND_SZ write, WM_SETTINGCHANGE broadcast; reader and writer injectable.
D2: the proof drives install() with an injected reader and writer over a fake Path, one tooth per clause.

out: bin/ (bin/proofs/test_cairn_resolves_from_powershell.py stays: it measures a different claim)

measured.saw: "'cairn' is not recognized" in PowerShell and a User Path without <repo>/bin
measured.how: `cairn superclaude` in PowerShell on akienlivingroom, then [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','User')
